mechanism:
@allosteric_mechanism begin
    substrates: S
    products: P
    allosteric_regulators: A
    catalytic_multiplicity: 2
    steps: begin
        E + P ⇌ E(P) :: EqualAI
        E + S ⇌ E(S) :: EqualAI
        E(S) <--> E(P) :: OnlyA
    end
    regulatory_site(2): A::OnlyA
end
rate_equation:
(; K_EP_to_E_P, K_ES_to_E_S, k_A_ES_to_EP, K_A_Areg, L, Keq, E_total) = params
(; S, P, A) = concs
# The coefficients are functions of the fitted constants, not parameters:
nA_0 = k_A_ES_to_EP / K_ES_to_E_S
dA_S = 1 / K_ES_to_E_S
dA_P = 1 / K_EP_to_E_P
dI_S = 1 / K_ES_to_E_S
dI_P = 1 / K_EP_to_E_P
Q_A = nA_0
D_A = 1 + dA_S * S + dA_P * P
D_I = 1 + dI_S * S + dI_P * P
W_A = (1 + A / K_A_Areg)^2
v = E_total * (Q_A * D_A * W_A) * (S - P / Keq) / (D_A^2 * W_A + L * D_I^2)
